Tooltip_WireBundle: A bundle of speaker wire. Use to connect speakers to a music device (Vinyl Player or HiFi Stereo). <LINE> <LINE> Contains 200ft of wire. Each connection uses 5ft per tile of distance.
Tooltip_TM_CD_Scratched: Scratched CDs skip tracks during playback. <LINE> Clean with Toothpaste or Peanut Butter and something clean to wipe with: <LINE> rag, bath towel, dish towel, napkins, tissue, toilet paper or cotton balls. <LINE> Each clean lowers the scratch one step: 100% > 75% > 50% > 25% > clean.
Tooltip_TM_CleanCD_Requires: Requires Toothpaste or Peanut Butter, plus something clean to wipe with: <LINE> rag, bath towel, dish towel, napkins, tissue, toilet paper or cotton balls. <LINE> The polish is used up; rags get dirty.
